updates.title: The Fabric Future is coming
updates.text: LOOP opens first in Mumbai and Pune. Early-access customers get priority pickups in launch week.
updates.body:
LOOP is almost here.

Our first stores open in Mumbai and Pune, with robotic, AI-sorted washing, low-water drying and doorstep pickup.

Early-access customers get priority pickups in launch week. Message us on WhatsApp to get on the list.

updates.title: Franchise applications are open
updates.text: Turnkey stores, premium equipment and full brand support. Talk to us about your city.

updates.title: First look at the LOOP store
updates.text: Black glass, warm light, robotic machines on show. This is what laundry looks like now.

updates.title: The LOOP app is in the works
updates.text: Book, track and pay from your phone. Every load, every step, live.
